per_candidate.id: s2:Asymmetry, Gap Opening, and a High Accretion Rate on DM Tau: A Hypothesis Based

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the specific question of reconciling observed distributions of planetesimals and formation rates of super-Earths with the Core Accretion model and pebble migration timescales. They are related to the broader topic of protoplanetary disks and planet formation but do not address the question directly.
